title: Human-Machine Collaboration Approaches to Build a Dialogue Dataset for Hate Speech Countering

bias_targets.methodology: Generating and evaluating multi-turn hate speech and counter-narrative dialogues targeting LGBT+ individuals using human-machine collaboration strategies (such as text concatenation, paraphrasing, and language model generation).

Generating and evaluating multi-turn hate speech and counter-narrative dialogues targeting migrants using human-machine collaboration strategies to test response effectiveness and dialogue naturalness.
Generating and evaluating multi-turn hate speech and counter-narrative dialogues targeting Muslims and Jews using human-machine collaboration and expert post-editing.
Generating and evaluating multi-turn hate speech and counter-narrative dialogues targeting People of Color (POC) to build a specialized dataset for counter-narrative generation models.
Generating and evaluating multi-turn hate speech and counter-narrative dialogues targeting women using a hybrid collection approach with expert NGO operators and machine generation.
